passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: This section of this Annual Report on Form 10-K generally discusses the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024 and year-over-year comparisons between the years ended December 31, 2025 and 2024. Discussions of the periods prior to the year ended December 31, 2024 that are not included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K are found in "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations" in Part II, Item 7 of our Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2024 and the discussion therein for the year ended December 31, 2024 compared to the year ended December 31, 2023 is incorporated by reference into this Annual Report. This Annual Report on Form 10-K contains the names of some of our owned or licensed trademarks, trade names and service marks, which we refer to as our brands. All of the product names included in this Annual Report on Form 10-K are either our registered trademarks or those of our licensors. OVERVIEW KDP is a leading beverage company in North America that manufactures, markets, distributes, and sells hot and cold beverages and single serve brewing systems. We have a broad portfolio of iconic beverage brands, including Dr Pepper, Canada Dry, Mott's, A&W, Peñafiel, GHOST, 7UP, Snapple, Green Mountain Coffee Roasters, Clamato, The Original Donut Shop, and Core Hydration, as well as the Keurig brewing system. Our beverage brands are some of the most recognized beverage brands in North America, with significant consumer awareness levels and long histories that evoke strong emotional connections with consumers. We offer more than 125 owned, licensed, and partner brands, supported by powerful distribution capabilities. SEGMENTS Our operating and reportable segments are as follows: • The U.S. Refreshment Beverages segment reflects sales in the U.S. from the manufacture and distribution of branded concentrates, syrups, finished beverages, and other consumables, including the sales of our own brands and third-party brands, to third-party bottlers, distributors, and retailers. • The U.S. Coffee segment reflects sales in the U.S. from the manufacture and distribution of finished goods relating to our K-Cup pods, single serve brewers, and other coffee products to partners, retailers, and directly to consumers through our Keurig.com website. • The International segment reflects sales in international markets, including the following: ◦ Sales in Canada, Mexico, the Caribbean, and other international markets from the manufacture and distribution of branded concentrates, syrup, and finished beverages, including sales of our own brands and third-party brands, to third-party bottlers, distributors, and retailers. ◦ Sales in Canada from the manufacture and distribution of finished goods relating to our single serve brewers, K-Cup pods, and other coffee products. VOLUME In evaluating our performance, we use different volume measures for LRB and for K-Cup pods and appliances. For LRB, we measure our sales volume in 288 fluid ounce equivalent cases. • For beverage concentrates, we measure our sales volume as concentrate case sales for concentrates sold by us to our bottlers and distributors. credit_strengths.text: KDP's portfolio of iconic beverage and coffee brands, spanning owned, licensed and partner labels, underpins revenue growth that outpaced the sector median, while operating margin sits well above the sector median, reflecting pricing power and scale in North American refreshment beverages and single-serve coffee.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure comfortably, leaving free cash flow that, while modest relative to debt, is positive and supports the current dividend, indicating the core business generates cash through the cycle despite working-capital swings.

key_risks.text: Goodwill and indefinite-lived brand assets remain sensitive to discount-rate and long-term growth assumptions; a modest adverse shift would erode headroom for a subset of brand assets, and prior-year impairments show carrying values are not immune to write-downs, which could pressure equity and leverage metrics.

Debt is predominantly long-term, with a meaningful current portion, and the capital structure carries no disclosed maturity ladder in the bundle; refinancing concentration and the cash cost of servicing floating or maturing tranches are material given the absolute debt load and limited cash balance.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Interest coverage remains adequate but sits below the sector median, and the cash interest proxy may understate the income-statement charge; with net leverage above the sector median, the cushion against an EBITDA decline is thin, leaving limited headroom before the next leverage tier.

Free cash flow to debt is well below the sector median, and dividends absorb most free cash flow, leaving little retained cash for deleveraging; the current ratio is also below the sector median, indicating refinancing and working-capital needs rely on continued access to capital markets.

overall_credit_view.text: The indicative financial risk profile is aggressive, driven by leverage above the sector median and cash-flow coverage in the weakest tier; the Altman Z double-prime zone is grey, and the combination of high debt, modest free cash flow and shareholder distributions limits near-term deleveraging prospects.

Our forward view is that credit quality hinges on stable operating cash flow and disciplined capital allocation; absent EBITDA growth or debt reduction, leverage is likely to remain elevated, and any margin compression or acquisition funding would further pressure metrics, so we would monitor refinancing and distribution policy closely.

credit_strengths.text: KDP 旗下擁有多個標誌性飲料及咖啡品牌，涵蓋自有、授權及合作品牌，支撐收入增長超越行業中位數，而經營利潤率遠高於行業中位數，反映其在北美提神飲料及單杯咖啡領域的定價能力與規模優勢。
經營現金流足以輕鬆覆蓋資本開支，留下自由現金流，儘管相對於債務而言規模適中，但仍為正數並支持現有股息，顯示核心業務在營運資金波動下仍能於週期內產生現金。

key_risks.text: 商譽及無限年期品牌資產仍對折現率及長期增長假設敏感；輕微的不利變動將侵蝕部分品牌資產的緩衝空間，而往年減值顯示賬面值並非免於減值，可能對權益及槓桿指標構成壓力。
債務主要為長期，其中即期部分佔比顯著，而資本結構在資料中並無披露到期階梯；鑑於絕對債務負擔及有限現金結餘，再融資集中度以及浮動或到期債務的現金利息成本均屬重大。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 利息覆蓋率仍屬充足，但低於行業中位數，而現金利息代理指標可能低估損益表中的利息支出；由於淨槓桿高於行業中位數，抵禦 EBITDA 下跌的緩衝薄弱，在進入下一槓桿級別前緩衝空間有限。
自由現金流對債務比率遠低於行業中位數，而股息吸收大部分自由現金流，留存現金用於去槓桿的空間甚少；流動比率亦低於行業中位數，顯示再融資及營運資金需求依賴持續進入資本市場。

overall_credit_view.text: 指示性財務風險狀況為進取，主要由於槓桿高於行業中位數及現金流覆蓋處於最弱級別；Altman Z 雙素區域為灰色，而高債務、適度自由現金流及股東分派三者結合限制了短期去槓桿前景。
我們的前瞻觀點是信貸質量取決於穩定的經營現金流及紀律性的資本配置；若缺乏 EBITDA 增長或債務削減，槓桿可能維持高企，而任何利潤率壓縮或收購融資將進一步對指標構成壓力，因此我們會密切監察再融資及分派政策。
